comment:
One of the best professors I had a University of Richmond. 
Being strict, fair, patient and accessible to students, Dr. Spear made the classes interesting.

Spear was one of the harder journalism professors I've had at UR, but in the end it all pays off. You learn SO much about copy editing in the course of a single semester. There's a lot of extra credit opportunities, and if you do the homework, a lot of it starts showing up again and again. If you work for it, it starts to become easier.

The absolute best. Funny and cares about his students, and has forgotten more about the English language than I'll ever know. He's also a UR legend. Highly, highly recommend to anyone who wants to become a better writer or editor.

Spear is absolutely awesome. He's caring, kind and genuine, and always has a story to tell. I learned a ton from his class, but it wasn't easy. Always be prepared because he calls on students randomly. He's an extremely hard grader on homework and quizzes but does everything possible for you to be well prepared. Take him - you won't regret it.

Don't expect to skate by, but for lower-level classes expect to gain skills and for upper-level classes expect to gain knowledge. You'll work for it, but it's worth it. Plan to attend every class and to read and write profusely. Spear himself is full of energy and stories to tell, which makes things interesting. Worthwhile prof to take.
I heart Mike Spear.  He's amazing.
incredible teacher, incredibly person. total genius, so wise, so interested in what is happening in the world.   he's an incredible writer.
I was only at UR for one semester, and I had Mono for most of the semester, but he was amazing. Honestly the best tutor i've ever had, and i've had a lot of tutors.

Spear is the best Prof at UR... hands down.  I don't care what time your class is, he's got so much spunk, he'll wake you up and keep you interested for the entire time.  He's so passionate and unique.  All hail Spear.
MS is awesome. He is down to earth and extremely intelligent. He is so good at what he teaches and his passion for journalism is so apparent. He is a wonderful man.

Sounds like Mr. Spear is still a hit more than 10 years after I was in his classroom.  Students -- Mike Spear will be there for you during your time at UR and for as long afterward as you are willing to stay in touch.  He is a wonderful person!

He is the best prof EVER. I can't say enough positive things about him. I learned so much, and had a good time in the process.  You will walk out of his class a smarter person, not only about the subject he's teaching, but about the world in general.
i love this man - he rocks! he's smart, funny and very helpful. i've had him for two classes and i felt a learned a lot in both and enjoyed them too. take anything from this guy - he's awesome.
He is the best teacher at University of Richmond. So intelligent, so eager to help with anything, so nice, so funny, so everything good anyone could want in a professor. Take him!
